sql: SELECT TOP 10 b.BlogNewsCode AS blogNewsCode, sl.SEOTitle AS seoTitle, b.BlogNewsId AS blogNewsId, b.ActivationDate AS activationDate, b.ExpirationDate AS expirationDate FROM dbo.ZnodeBlogNews b INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = b.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetail s ON s.SEOCode = b.BlogNewsCode AND s.PortalId = b.PortalId AND s.CMSSEOTypeId IN (SELECT t.CMSSEOTypeId FROM dbo.ZnodeCMSSEOType t WHERE t.Name = @seoType) LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEOType st ON st.CMSSEOTypeId = s.CMSSEOTypeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetailLocale sl ON sl.CMSSEODetailId = s.CMSSEODetailId AND sl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND b.BlogNewsType = @blogNewsType AND ((@state = @futureState AND b.ActivationDate > @now) OR (@state = @expiredState AND b.ExpirationDate < @now)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT o.BlogNewsId FROM dbo.ZnodeBlogNews o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetail os ON os.SEOCode = o.BlogNewsCode AND os.PortalId = o.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEOType ost ON ost.CMSSEOTypeId = os.CMSSEOTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetailLocale osl ON osl.CMSSEODetailId = os.CMSSEODetailId AND osl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE o.PortalId = b.PortalId AND o.BlogNewsId <> b.BlogNewsId AND ost.Name = @seoType AND o.IsBlogNewsActive = @isActive AND (o.ActivationDate IS NULL OR o.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (o.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR o.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND CHARINDEX(b.BlogNewsCode, osl.SEOTitle) > @zero) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR b.BlogNewsCode = @preferred) ORDER BY b.BlogNewsId
